lines.say: Your job is standing in queues for rich people. Twenty dollars an hour.
Monday you queue for new phones. Tuesday for concert tickets.
Wednesday the queue is three days long. You sleep on the pavement.
You finally reach the front. A sign. Jobs, one opening.
The job is yours. Your boss replaced you. You were queuing for your own job, for someone richer.
Would you take the queue job? Write it in the comments.
